name: Blue Zkittlez
summary: **Blue Zkittlez** is a [[kind:cultivar|cultivar]] released by [[breeder:Dying Breed Seeds]] as a cross of [[zkittlez|Zkittlez]] and [[blue-diamond|Blue Diamond]]. The breeder's own published genealogy instead lists a related cut called the Original Z in place of Zkittlez.
